theme: Fish combinations, stroke constructions and source-qualified object context
question: Do fish forms make ordered compounds, do their preceding strokes favour fixed expressions over variable quantities, and what source-qualified contexts discriminate celestial, designation and commodity readings?
outcome: The register retains 1246 provisional objects, 1274 fish-bearing faces and all 1520 faces of those objects. It links 846 objects to CISI basic data, 409 to excavation-table rows and 838 to indexed images. The frozen fish order wins in 43 dependency groups, loses in eight and ties in two (one-sided exact p=3.433558868337627e-7). Fish-specific numeral probabilities beat the general quantity reference by 0.5450 bits per component, but deleting value two removes the gain and a preceding-context reference predicts slightly better. The narrow short-stroke/plain-fish celestial model fails its minimum-size, coverage and predictive rules. Calibrated seal preference fails (p=0.4855; exact enumeration p=0.48333). The acquired Parpola 2010 Figure 6 matches H-912 B, although its caption and prose say H-902. Forty arithmetic and integrity checks pass.
challenge: The corpus and related statistic families were historically examined. A reserved half supplies a frozen evaluation without fresh-population status. Two-stroke constructions dominate the numeral result; the quantity reference omits standard economic quotas. Only 17 groups qualify for the narrow celestial comparison. No inscription is joined to an independently identified fish-bone lot, measured content or authenticated owner. A paper's reused CISI photograph is not an additional physical object.
remedy: Used the shared shots loader, registered one participant and froze code and predictions before one logged confirmation read. Preserved failed discovery v1, the power-helper threshold discrepancy, failed HTTP downloads and earlier coverage counters. Compared stronger references after a recorded post-outcome amendment, retained source conflicts and missing images, checked all indexed image hashes, and independently recalculated exact vote tails and all 120 carrier-label allocations. Current working credences are 0.45 for compound designations, 0.05 for the narrow asterism-coverage claim and 0.35 for the inherited four-vessel-units-of-fish reading on H-912 B; these are judgements with prospective kill conditions.
retry_when: New source-checked compound seal texts can test the frozen order; or registered tablets and containers have independent measured capacity, contents or allotment observations. A new seed over examined objects adds no population. An adjacent-stroke model cannot adjudicate H-912 B's intervening vessel sign.
